failure_case.proposition: Selected raw body early return: parent is NULL, item is NULL, or item differs from parent.child and item.prev is NULL; not every invalid-membership input.

invalid_membership.proposition: Positive caller-side evidence that nonnull item is not an owned child of the selected parent; not merely failed membership proof.

membership.proposition: Exact selected nonnull item is contained in the live parent at entry; caller membership is independently required, never inferred from Borrowed provenance.

original_list_unchanged.proposition: For the exact early-return case the link heap equals the entry link heap; says nothing about arbitrary invalid lists.

remaining_list_valid.proposition: For the exact successful call, remaining owned children retain the representation and removed item has NULL prev and next.

success_case.proposition: Selected raw body exits returning the same nonnull item after unlinking under all representation and containment prerequisites.
